summary: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 3-1 defeat to New Mills in their recent fixture, with an unfortunate own goal in injury time sealing the loss after they'd fought back to level at 1-1. The team showed resilience throughout, with Stan making a crucial last-ditch tackle and Bev having a late chance well-blocked, but ultimately couldn't hold on for a result. Despite the tough start, there's plenty of football left in the season ahead.
